description: MindCommit policy rules — controls what the Elon Musk Knowledge Twin agent can and cannot do

rules.description: Allow reading files from Google Drive for knowledge ingestion
Allow all Notion read operations for knowledge ingestion
Allow all GitHub read operations for code knowledge
Allow YouTube read operations for interview/talk ingestion
Allow reading calendar events for temporal context
Allow web scraping for public content ingestion
Require approval before sending emails via Gmail
rules.message: MindCommit wants to send an email (Answer Receipt). Please review and approve.

rules.description: Allow reading Gmail messages for knowledge ingestion
Require approval before posting to Slack
rules.message: MindCommit wants to post an answer to Slack. Please review and approve.

rules.description: Allow reading Slack history for context
Require approval before sending Telegram messages
rules.message: MindCommit wants to send a Telegram message. Please review and approve.

rules.description: Require approval before sending transactional emails via Resend
rules.message: MindCommit wants to send an Answer Receipt email via Resend. Please review.

rules.description: Require approval before creating calendar events
rules.message: MindCommit wants to create a calendar event. Please review.

rules.description: Deny ALL destructive operations across ALL integrations
rules.message: Destructive operations are never permitted by MindCommit. Knowledge is append-only.

rules.description: Rate limit all outbound communications to prevent spam
Rate limit web scraping to be respectful
